title: Continuation Terms of the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan: Renewal, Pause, Lapse and Reinstatement
content:
**1.** Every plan of the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan renews without the host acting, and the host is told before the renewal by the number of calendar days their plan sets.

**2.** Each plan sets the longest single stretch a pause may run, the number of pauses allowed over a rolling year, the period an unpaid fee may stand before the plan falls away, the window within which a fallen plan may be restored, the fee for restoring it, and the percentage of the unused term returned where the host cancels.

| Plan | Term renews without the host acting | Notice before renewal (calendar days) | Longest single pause (calendar days) | Pauses in a rolling year | Unpaid fee may stand for (calendar days) | Reinstatement window (calendar days) | Reinstatement fee (USD) | Unused term returned on cancellation (percent) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Care Essentials Plan | Yes | 30 | 60 | 2 | 30 | 30 | 25.00 | 0 |
| Keyturn Care Routine Plan | Yes | 30 | 60 | 2 | 30 | 45 | 25.00 | 50 |
| Keyturn Care Complete Plan | Yes | 30 | 45 | 3 | 45 | 45 | 35.00 | 60 |
| Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan | Yes | 45 | 30 | 3 | 45 | 60 | 45.00 | 70 |
| Keyturn Care Fleet Plan | Yes | 45 | 30 | 2 | 60 | 60 | 65.00 | 75 |
| Keyturn Care Electric Plan | Yes | 30 | 45 | 3 | 45 | 45 | 45.00 | 65 |

**3.** A refund percentage of 0 stands against the Keyturn Care Essentials Plan, on which no part of the unused term is returned.

**4.** The longest single pause and the number of pauses allowed move against one another across the card: the Keyturn Care Essentials Plan and the Keyturn Care Routine Plan allow the longest stretch, 60 calendar days, but only 2 pauses in a rolling year, while the Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan allows 3 pauses of no more than 30 calendar days each. The Keyturn Care Fleet Plan allows 2 pauses of no more than 30 calendar days, and gives the longest unpaid period of the six at 60 calendar days.
